firmographics.narrative_md:
ProPartners Financial (PPF) operates as Compeer Financial, PCA d/b/a ProPartners Financial, a specialized crop input lending entity within the Farm Credit System. Founded in 2001, PPF is the system's designated Center of Excellence for input financing programs [E-006:F2]. The entity is owned by nine Farm Credit associations with combined assets exceeding $36 billion and combined capital of $6.2 billion [E-008:F3]. PPF maintains operations centers in St. Paul, Minnesota (primary) and Normal, Illinois (secondary), with relationship staff covering the continental United States [E-006:F1].

PPF's operating model is distinctive: technology operations are outsourced to GreenStone Farm Credit Services, HR administration is handled by Compeer Financial, and hiring uses the Greenhouse ATS hosted through GreenStone's careers portal [E-006:F9]. This creates a lean 53-person organization focused on credit, relationships, and product management while dependent on owner associations for technology infrastructure and back-office functions.
